title: Fragments on the Song of Songs
blurb: Cyril of Alexandria reads the Song of Songs as the love between Christ and His Church, in short Greek fragments printed in PG 69, given here in a fresh English translation.
first_english_note: A fresh English translation of Cyril's Fragmenta in Canticum canticorum, made from the Greek of PG 69. No modern English translation was used as wording, and the work has no ANF or NPNF English.

text_history.method: Fresh English translation from the Greek of PG 69 (Fragmenta in Canticum canticorum).
